user.title: Connect to ecoNET Cloud
user.description: Enter the account used on econetcloud.eu. This integration monitors your ventilation unit and exposes supported speeds, operating modes and comfort temperatures. The password is used only to sign in and is not saved. Home Assistant stores session data needed to renew the connection.

connection.title: Fetch ecoNET Cloud installations
connection.description: The account is authenticated. Retry loading the installation data; entering the password again is not required.

error.session_auth: Session renewal was rejected. Sign in again.
error.additional_auth: An additional authentication step is required.
error.cloud_authorization: Sign-in succeeded, but access to the installation data was not granted.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to ecoNET Cloud.
error.no_installations: No installations were found for this account.
error.wrong_account: This account cannot access the previously selected installation.

abort.not_found: The selected installation was not found.
